segments.name: Payroll and Human Capital Management
segments.description: Cloud-based HCM software and services for payroll processing, HR management, compliance, and workforce administration to businesses of all sizes.
segments.evidence: we determined that we have a single reportable segment that primarily derives its revenue in the United States by providing payroll services to customers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay recurring per-employee-per-month fees, transaction-based processing fees, implementation and setup fees, payment processing and funds movement fees, and hardware sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is generated through a combination of recurring per-employee-per-month fees, transaction-based processing fees, implementation and setup fees, fees associated with payment processing and funds movement, and hardware sales and Hardware-as-a-Service ("HaaS") arrangements.
